03. Data Dictionary

Vehicle master

  • vehicle_id: unique vehicle identifier

  • vin: vehicle identification number

  • model: vehicle model name

  • model_year: manufacturing year

  • region: geographic region

  • dealer_id: dealer or service partner ID

  • battery_capacity_kwh: battery capacity in kWh

  • manufacture_date: manufacturing date

Telemetry

  • vehicle_id

  • event_timestamp

  • event_date

  • year

  • month

  • region

  • speed_kmh

  • battery_level

  • battery_temperature

  • engine_temperature

  • latitude

  • longitude

  • fault_code

Sales

  • sale_id

  • vehicle_id

  • dealer_id

  • model

  • region

  • sale_date

  • sale_amount

Maintenance

  • maintenance_id

  • vehicle_id

  • service_date

  • service_type

  • repair_cost

  • dealer_id

Warranty

  • claim_id

  • vehicle_id

  • component

  • claim_date

  • claim_amount

  • dealer_id
